splits.cal_traces: <=300, groups ordered by sha256([loc,date]), round-robin, traces by sha256([loc,date,start])

development_material: t1-t10 and their loc-days, the prior library, the t9/t10 pool (2026-10-15..10-25, stats seen in t910/sampling_log.txt)

sealed_test_pool.source: ped_poll live collection (qsim/ped2026 snapshots), merged after the last date completes
sealed_test_pool.excluded_locdays: none in range (all development loc-days are earlier)
sealed_test_pool.rule: candidates sorted, random.Random(20261026).shuffle; general = first passing the general band; stress = first passing the stress band with (loc,date) != general; no stress passer -> report missing (no substitute). Trace ids = next unused (t11/t12 if unused at draw time).
sealed_test_pool.draw_time: after Melbourne 2026-10-27 is complete (~2026-10-27 15:15Z rollover) and before any method score on these dates; P0 checks data quality only

profiling_runs: gate-1 runs of v8sim11 (t1/t2/t4, r272-r320 era; v8sim11 PHYS)
P1_replay.selection_rule: every run flagged ok in ab/g/h/rr ledgers from 2026-10-22 on (harness r34a/b/c, complete per-run logs), minus the profiling runs; fixed before any event_phys output on hardware data

modes.observed_event_replay: inject observed dispatches, observed arrivals/departures with their slots, observed VyOS dataplane-ready and slot API times where logged; compare reconstructed per-slot UE counts with prom upf_sessions (15 s) at minute ends with no move/drain in flight; other minutes UNKNOWN
modes.causal_replay: inject only the observed controller dispatch times (scale-out/in slot, VyOS deploy/delete, worker create/delete) and the trace targets; start = observed fleet and per-slot counts at formal t0; ready, placement, relief, drains, loss, cost from event_phys with the fixed profiling constants

P1_replay.hardware_classes: per-minute SLO (e2e<=0.1 % and p99<=1 ms) and classes fleet/placement/other from qsim/r66rr/hit/classify_b2.py (unchanged)

metrics.event: episode = maximal run of consecutive hardware minutes classified fleet or placement; recalled if the causal replay marks a bad minute in [first-1, last+1]
metrics.recall_gate: >= 0.80 with >= 5 separated episodes over >= 3 runs (else BLOCKED)
metrics.false_alarm_gate: model bad minutes among hardware-clean minutes / hardware-clean minutes <= 0.05 (exact minute)
metrics.cost_gate: mean over runs of |model alloc_vm - hardware alloc_vm| / hardware alloc_vm <= 0.03 (hardware alloc_vm from paper_out_new/rq/rq_metrics.csv or rq_metrics.py)
metrics.state_gate: observed replay: comparable minutes with per-slot count mismatch = 0
